title: Maximal Range That Each Element Is Maximum in It
summary: Given an array of distinct integers, create an array where each element represents the longest subarray starting or ending at the corresponding index, with that element being the maximum in the subarray.
statement: Given an array of distinct integers, create an array where each element represents the longest subarray starting or ending at the corresponding index, with that element being the maximum in the subarray. Return this array.
constraints: For every index, return the longest contiguous range containing it in which its value is the maximum.
hints: A value can extend until the first greater value on either side.
Use decreasing stacks to find those two blocking indices.
Compute right blocker minus left blocker minus one.
Every interior value is smaller and each boundary is the nearest violation, making the range maximal.
editorial: Every interior value is smaller and each boundary is the nearest violation, making the range maximal.
